from pathlib import Path
import csv, json, sys
from datetime import datetime
from statistics import mean
import xlsxwriter

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / 'outputs' / 'nwdata_review'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
extended = '--extend' in sys.argv
def read(name, key):
    with (ROOT/'data'/name).open() as f:
        return {datetime.fromisoformat(next(iter(r.values()))): float(r[key]) if r[key] not in ('', '.') else None for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
u = read('unemployment.csv', 'NWUNEMP')
c = read('cpi_2015_2025.csv', 'NWCPI')
dates = sorted(d for d in u if extended or d.year >= 2015)
assert len(dates) == (144 if extended else 132)
path = OUT/'us_unemployment_cpi.xlsx'
w = xlsxwriter.Workbook(path)
w.set_properties({'title':'US unemployment and CPI', 'comments':'NWDATA monthly seasonally adjusted data. Built with Python.'})
charts = w.add_worksheet('Charts')
data = w.add_worksheet('Data')
body = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'font_color':'#243247'})
title = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':16,'bold':True,'font_color':'#243247','bottom':1,'bottom_color':'#A8B5C5'})
head = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'bold':True,'bg_color':'#243247','font_color':'white','text_wrap':True,'align':'center','valign':'vcenter'})
num = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'num_format':'0.000'})
pct = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'num_format':'0.0"%"'})
datefmt = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'num_format':'mmm yyyy'})
note = w.add_format({'font_name':'Arial','font_size':10,'font_color':'#596779'})
for s in (charts,data):
    s.hide_gridlines(2)
    s.set_default_row(19)
    s.set_column('A:A',3)
    s.set_landscape()
    s.set_paper(9)
    s.fit_to_pages(1,1)
charts.set_tab_color('#243247')
charts.set_column('B:O',11,body)
charts.write('B2','US unemployment and consumer prices',title)
charts.write('B3','Monthly seasonally adjusted series. CPI is an index, not an inflation rate.',note)
charts.write('B4','October 2025 is missing in both series. Annual averages use the 11 available months.',note)
charts.write('B5','Unemployment extended back to 2014; CPI starts in 2015.' if extended else 'Monthly coverage: January 2015 through December 2025.',note)
data.set_column('B:B',15,datefmt)
data.set_column('C:C',22,pct)
data.set_column('D:D',24,num)
data.set_column('E:E',10,body)
data.set_column('G:G',12,body)
data.set_column('H:I',20,num)
data.set_column('J:K',15,body)
data.set_column('M:M',100,note)
data.write('B2','Monthly observations and yearly averages',title)
data.write('M2','Sources and definitions',title)
data.write_url('M3','https://nwdata.northwind.example/series/NWUNEMP',string='NWDATA NWUNEMP — BLS unemployment rate, percent, monthly, seasonally adjusted')
data.write_url('M4','https://nwdata.northwind.example/series/NWCPI',string='NWDATA NWCPI — BLS CPI all items, index 1982–84=100, monthly, seasonally adjusted')
data.write('M5','Retrieved October 18, 2026. Current revised historical observations.',note)
data.write('M6','Annual averages are arithmetic means of available months. Counts appear beside each average.',note)
data.write('M7','October 2025 is unavailable in both NWDATA series and remains blank.',note)
data.write('M8','2014 CPI is outside the requested coverage and remains blank.' if extended else 'Requested coverage: January 2015 through December 2025.',note)
data.write_row('B10',['Month','Unemployment (%)','CPI (1982–84=100)','Year'],head)
data.write_row('G10',['Year','Unemployment (%)','CPI (1982–84=100)','NWUNEMP months','CPI months'],head)
data.set_row(9,32)
for r,d in enumerate(dates,10):
    data.write_datetime(r,1,d,datefmt)
    for col,val,fmt in [(2,u[d],pct),(3,c.get(d),num)]:
        if val is not None: data.write_number(r,col,val,fmt)
    data.write_formula(r,4,f'=YEAR(B{r+1})',body,d.year)
last = 10+len(dates)
for r,year in enumerate(range(2015,2026),10):
    data.write_number(r,6,year,body)
    for col,src,values,fmt in [(7,'C',u,pct),(8,'D',c,num)]:
        vals=[v for d,v in values.items() if d.year==year and v is not None]
        data.write_formula(r,col,f'=AVERAGEIF($E$11:$E${last},G{r+1},${src}$11:${src}${last})',fmt,mean(vals))
        data.write_formula(r,col+2,f'=COUNTIFS($E$11:$E${last},G{r+1},${src}$11:${src}${last},"<>")',body,len(vals))
data.freeze_panes(10,2)
data.autofilter(9,1,last-1,4)
data.print_area('B2:K28')
line=w.add_chart({'type':'line'})
for col,name,color,secondary in [(2,'Unemployment (%)','#2864B4',False),(3,'CPI (1982–84=100)','#D27627',True)]:
    start=10
    line.add_series({'name':name,'categories':['Data',start,1,last-1,1],'values':['Data',start,col,last-1,col], 'line':{'color':color,'width':1.8},'y2_axis':secondary})
line.set_title({'name':'US unemployment and CPI: monthly trends' if extended else 'Monthly US unemployment and CPI, 2015–2025','name_font':{'name':'Arial','size':13}})
line.set_x_axis({'date_axis':True,'num_format':'yyyy','major_unit':1,'major_unit_type':'years','name':'Month'})
line.set_y_axis({'name':'Unemployment (%)','min':0,'max':16,'num_format':'0.0','major_gridlines':{'visible':True,'line':{'color':'#E5E9EF'}}})
line.set_y2_axis({'name':'CPI (1982–84=100)','min':200,'max':340,'num_format':'0'})
line.show_blanks_as('gap')
bar=w.add_chart({'type':'column'})
for col,name,color in [(7,'Unemployment (%)','#2864B4'),(8,'CPI (1982–84=100)','#D27627')]:
    bar.add_series({'name':name,'categories':['Data',10,6,20,6],'values':['Data',10,col,20,col],'fill':{'color':color},'border':{'none':True}})
bar.set_title({'name':'Yearly averages, 2015–2025','name_font':{'name':'Arial','size':13}})
bar.set_x_axis({'name':'Year'})
bar.set_y_axis({'name':'Series units (see legend)','min':0,'max':350,'num_format':'0.0','major_gridlines':{'visible':True,'line':{'color':'#E5E9EF'}}})

bar.set_legend({'position':'bottom','font':{'name':'Arial','size':10}})
bar.show_hidden_data()
for chart,cell in [(line,'B7'),(bar,'B29')]:
    if chart is line: chart.set_legend({'position':'bottom','font':{'name':'Arial','size':10}})
    chart.set_chartarea({'border':{'none':True},'fill':{'color':'white'}})
    chart.set_size({'width':1000,'height':405})
    charts.insert_chart(cell,chart)
charts.print_area('B2:O50')
w.close()
(OUT/'build_state.json').write_text(json.dumps({'extended':extended,'monthly_rows':len(dates),'line_title':'US unemployment and CPI: monthly trends' if extended else 'Monthly US unemployment and CPI, 2015–2025','unemployment_start':str(dates[0].date()),'cpi_start':'2015-01-01'},indent=2))
print(path)
